card.name: Charles Darwin
card.power: Sympathy Instinct: Play to cancel a "Selfish" action.
card.lore: Sympathy will have been increased through natural selection. (Ref: Darwin)

line: Charles Darwin, Sympathy Instinct: cancel a selfish action. Sympathy increased through natural selection.

card.name: The Selfish Gene
card.power: Ego Boost: Gain control of the narrative, but isolate your Actor.
card.lore: We are survival machines—robot vehicles blindly programmed. (Ref: Dawkins)

line: The Selfish Gene, Ego Boost: control of the narrative, but your Actor isolated. Survival machines, robot vehicles blindly programmed.

card.name: Lynn Margulis
card.power: Symbiosis: Combine two Scene cards into one stronger card.
card.lore: Life did not take over the globe by combat, but by networking. (Ref: Margulis)

line: Lynn Margulis, Symbiosis? Two cards, one stronger. Life did not take over the globe by combat, but by networking.

card.name: Survival of the Friendliest
card.power: Domestication: Turn an enemy card into an ally.
card.lore: Evolution favors those who can get along. (Ref: Hare & Woods)

line: Survival of the Friendliest, Domestication: an enemy turned ally. Evolution favors those who can get along.

card.name: Mirror Neurons
card.power: Reflection: Copy the Effect/Power of the last card played.
card.lore: Why I feel what you feel. Intuitive communication. (Ref: Bauer)

line: Mirror Neurons, Reflection: copy the last card played. Why I feel what you feel; intuitive communication.

card.name: Oxytocin
card.power: The Cuddle Hormone: Heal a fractured Stage or lower the Quest Die by 1.
card.lore: Increases trust, reduces fear. Warning: Can cause aggression against 'outsiders'.

line: Oxytocin, the Cuddle Hormone: heal a fractured Stage. Increases trust, reduces fear. Warning: can cause aggression against outsiders.

card.name: The Vagus Nerve
card.power: Calm Down: Reset the Quest Die to 3.
card.lore: The wandering nerve of compassion. Stimulate for peace.

line: The Vagus Nerve, Calm Down: the wandering nerve of compassion. Stimulate for peace.

card.name: Pain Center
card.power: Social Reject: Inflict 'Damage' on an Actor who is ignored.
card.lore: Social rejection activates the same brain regions as physical pain. (Ref: Lieberman)

line: Pain Center, Social Reject: inflict damage on an ignored Actor. Social rejection activates the same brain regions as physical pain.

card.name: Thomas Hobbes
card.power: Leviathan: Impose strict order. No other player may speak this turn.
card.lore: "Life is nasty, brutish, and short. War of all against all."

line: Thomas Hobbes, Leviathan: strict order, no other may speak. Life nasty, brutish, and short. War of all against all.

card.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
card.power: Natural Goodness: Remove a 'Corruption' or 'Civilization' effect.
card.lore: "Man is born free, and everywhere he is in chains."

line: Jean-Jacques Rousseau, Natural Goodness: man born free, everywhere in chains.

card.name: Rutger Bregman
card.power: Humankind: Re-roll the die if the result was cynical/negative.
card.lore: "Most people, deep down, are pretty decent." (Ref: Im Grunde gut)

line: Rutger Bregman, Humankind? Re-roll if cynical. Most people, deep down, are pretty decent.

card.name: Lord of the Flies
card.power: Fiction Trap: Create a false conflict.
card.lore: "A story we tell ourselves. Real kids on islands cooperated. (Ref: Golding vs. Reality)"

line: Lord of the Flies, Fiction Trap: a false conflict. A story we tell ourselves; real kids on islands cooperated.

card.name: Michael Tomasello
card.power: Pointing: Reveal a hidden card from another player's hand.
card.lore: "We cooperate to survive. Shared Intentionality. (Ref: Why We Cooperate)"

line: Michael Tomasello, Pointing: reveal a hidden card. We cooperate to survive; shared intentionality.

card.name: The Stag Hunt
card.power: Joint Effort: Works only if another player helps. Effect is doubled.
card.lore: "I can't catch the stag alone. If I chase the rabbit, we both lose."

line: The Stag Hunt, Joint Effort: I can't catch the stag alone. If I chase the rabbit, we both lose.

card.name: The Free Rider
card.power: Exploit: Steal the benefit of the previous player's action.
card.lore: The fear of being suckered. The reason we invented punishment.

line: The Free Rider, Exploit: steal the benefit. The fear of being suckered, the reason we invented punishment.

card.name: The Commons
card.power: Elinor Ostrom: All players draw 1 card.
card.lore: What we share grows, unless we believe the tragedy myth. (Ref: Ostrom)

line: The Commons, Elinor Ostrom: all players draw. What we share grows, unless we believe the tragedy myth.

card.name: Frans de Waal
card.power: Reconciliation: Restore peace after a conflict scene.
card.lore: "Empathy is biological, not a choice. The Age of Empathy."

line: Frans de Waal, Reconciliation: peace after conflict. Empathy is biological, not a choice. The Age of Empathy.

card.name: The Psychopath
card.power: CEO Status: Ignore the negative consequences of a decision.
card.lore: "1% of people. 4% of CEOs. They know the lyrics but not the music."

line: The Psychopath, CEO Status: ignore the negative consequences. They know the lyrics but not the music.

card.name: Emotional Contagion
card.power: Vibe Check: Change the mood of the Stage to match your Actor.
card.lore: "We catch feelings faster than viruses. (Ref: Christakis)"

line: Emotional Contagion, Vibe Check: the mood of the Stage matches your Actor. We catch feelings faster than viruses.

card.name: Veneer Theory
card.power: Cynicism: Negate a "Good" act.
card.lore: "The myth that civilization is just a thin layer over a beast. BLÖDSINN!"

opener: Here is something nobody asked for
line: Veneer Theory. Cynicism. Negate a good act. The myth that civilization is just a thin layer over a beast. Blödsinn!

card.name: Homo Economicus
card.power: Rational Fool: Make a decision that benefits only you, lose 1 Friend.
card.lore: A rational utility maximizer who doesn't exist. (Ref: Game Theory)

line: Homo Economicus, Rational Fool: a decision that benefits only you, lose a Friend. A rational utility maximizer who doesn't exist.

card.name: The Filter Bubble
card.power: Echo Chamber: Ignore any card played by a 'Different' species.
card.lore: We only see what the algorithm wants us to see. (Ref: Pariser)

line: The Filter Bubble, Echo Chamber: ignore any different species. We only see what the algorithm wants us to see.

card.name: Loneliness
card.power: Health Hazard: -1 to Quest Die.
card.lore: As deadly as 15 cigarettes a day. A biological warning signal.

line: Loneliness, Health Hazard: as deadly as 15 cigarettes a day. A biological warning signal.

card.name: Digital Distraction
card.power: Scroll Doom: Skip your turn to draw a card.
card.lore: We are alone together. Connection without demand. (Ref: Turkle)

line: Digital Distraction, Scroll Doom: skip your turn, draw a card. We are alone together; connection without demand.

card.name: Intrinsic Motivation
card.power: Flow State: Play an extra card if it fits the story perfectly.
card.lore: Doing it because you love it. Rewards can kill this. (Ref: Deci & Ryan)

line: Intrinsic Motivation, Flow State: it fits the story perfectly. Doing it because you love it. Rewards can kill this.

card.name: Homo Cooperativus
card.power: Synergy: +1 to Quest Die for every player who helps.
card.lore: We are designed to work together. (Ref: Sennett)

line: Homo Cooperativus, Synergy: for every player who helps. We are designed to work together.

card.name: Bullshit Jobs
card.power: Resignation: Discard a card to do nothing.
card.lore: Work that serves no purpose. Soul-destroying. (Ref: Graeber)

line: Bullshit Jobs, Resignation: discard a card to do nothing. Work that serves no purpose. Soul-destroying.

card.name: The Nudge
card.power: Choice Arch: Influence the next player's decision without forcing them.
card.lore: Small changes in context can change behavior. (Ref: Thaler)

line: The Nudge, Choice Arch: influence the next decision without forcing. Small changes in context can change behavior.

card.name: Homo Hapticus
card.power: Touch: Connect two separated cards.
card.lore: We cannot live without touch. The skin is our social organ. (Ref: Grunwald)

line: Homo Hapticus, Touch: connect two separated cards. We cannot live without touch; the skin is our social organ.

card.name: Resonance
card.power: Hartmut Rosa: Amplify the current 'Vibe'.
card.lore: When the world answers us. Not echo, but answer.

line: Resonance, Hartmut Rosa? Amplify the Vibe. When the world answers us. Not echo, but answer.

card.name: Skin Hunger
card.power: Desperation: Force a connection (play a card on top of another).
card.lore: A biological deficit. We wither without contact.

line: Skin Hunger, Desperation: force a connection. A biological deficit. We wither without contact.

card.name: Flow
card.power: Immersion: The Quest Die cannot be tipped this turn.
card.lore: Total absorption. The ego dissolves. (Ref: Csikszentmihalyi)

line: Flow, Immersion: the Die cannot be tipped. Total absorption; the ego dissolves.

card.name: The Killing Inhibition
card.power: Missed Shot: Negate an attack or aggressive move.
card.lore: Most soldiers didn't shoot to kill. We are not natural killers. (Ref: Marshall)

line: The Killing Inhibition. Missed Shot. Negate an attack. Most soldiers didn't shoot to kill; we are not natural killers.

card.name: The Christmas Truce
card.power: Ceasefire: Pause the Quest Die for one round.
card.lore: When the propaganda failed, they played football. 1914.

line: The Christmas Truce, Ceasefire: pause. When the propaganda failed, they played football. 1914.

card.name: Propaganda
card.power: Dehumanize: Turn a 'Friend' card into an 'Enemy'.
card.lore: We need to be lied to in order to kill. (Ref: Bernays)

line: Propaganda, Dehumanize: a Friend turned Enemy. We need to be lied to in order to kill.

card.name: Non-Violent Resistance
card.power: Civil Disobedience: Stop the game flow to change a rule.
card.lore: Power comes from obedience. Withdraw it. (Ref: Gandhi)

line: Non-Violent Resistance. Civil Disobedience. Stop the game to change a rule. Power comes from obedience. Withdraw it.

card.name: The Alpha Myth
card.power: Debunk: Remove a 'Leader' status.
card.lore: Real alphas are caretakers, not bullies. (Ref: Mech)

line: The Alpha Myth, Debunk: remove a Leader status. Real alphas are caretakers, not bullies.

card.name: Leveling Mechanism
card.power: Ridicule: The player with the most cards must discard one.
card.lore: Cutting down the tall poppy. Keeping egos in check. (Ref: Boehm)

line: Leveling Mechanism, Ridicule: the player with the most cards discards. Cutting down the tall poppy, keeping egos in check.

card.name: Corruption of Power
card.power: Brain Damage: Gain power, but lose Empathy (cannot assist others).
card.lore: Power causes brain damage. It shuts down mirror neurons. (Ref: Keltner)

line: Corruption of Power, Brain Damage: gain power, lose Empathy. Power causes brain damage; it shuts down mirror neurons.

card.name: Egalitarianism
card.power: Round Table: Everyone draws a card.
card.lore: For 95% of human history, we lived as equals. (Ref: Graeber/Wengrow)

line: Egalitarianism. Round Table. Everyone draws a card. For 95% of human history, we lived as equals.

card.name: The Helper Toddler
card.power: Innate Goodness: Aid another player freely.
card.lore: We help before we can talk. It's not taught, it's there. (Ref: Warneken)

line: The Helper Toddler, Innate Goodness: aid another freely. We help before we can talk; not taught, it's there.

card.name: Alloparenting
card.power: It Takes A Village: Use another player's Skill/Power.
card.lore: Mothers and Others. We share the burden. (Ref: Hrdy)

line: Alloparenting, It Takes a Village: use another player's power. Mothers and Others; we share the burden.

card.name: Homo Ludens (Play)
card.power: Reset: Clear the Stage (it was just a game).
card.lore: Play is the foundation of culture. It requires trust. (Ref: Huizinga)

line: Homo Ludens (Play), Reset: clear the Stage, just a game. Play is the foundation of culture; it requires trust.

card.name: Conditioned Self
card.power: Schooling: Force a card to conform to a specific suit/color.
card.lore: We are taught to compete. We are molded. (Ref: Kohn)

line: Conditioned Self, Schooling: force a card to conform. We are taught to compete. We are molded.

card.name: Immanuel Kant
card.power: Categorical Imperative: Establish a Universal Rule for the game.
card.lore: "The starry sky above me, the moral law within me."

line: Immanuel Kant, Categorical Imperative: a Universal Rule for the game. The starry sky above me, the moral law within me.

card.name: Erich Fromm
card.power: To Be: Immunize an Actor against material loss.
card.lore: "To Have or To Be? That is the question of sanity."

line: Erich Fromm, To Be: an Actor immunized against material loss. To Have or To Be? The question of sanity.

card.name: Martin Buber
card.power: I and Thou: Create an unbreakable bond between two Actors.
card.lore: "All real living is meeting. No 'It', only 'Thou.'"

line: Martin Buber, I and Thou: an unbreakable bond. All real living is meeting. No It, only Thou.

card.name: Hannah Arendt
card.power: Action: Start a new narrative thread (Quest).
card.lore: "The banality of evil. But also the power of beginning."

line: Hannah Arendt, Action: start a new thread. The banality of evil, but also the power of beginning.

card.name: Protopia
card.power: Incremental Gain: +1 to the Die roll.
card.lore: Not Utopia. Just a little bit better than yesterday. (Ref: Kevin Kelly)

line: Protopia, Incremental Gain: not Utopia. Just a little bit better than yesterday.

card.name: Team Human
card.power: Find the Others: Unite all players against the Quest.
card.lore: Being human is a team sport. (Ref: Douglas Rushkoff)

line: Team Human, Find the Others: all players united against the Quest. Being human is a team sport.

card.name: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
card.power: Manifest: If you say it happens, it happens.
card.lore: If we believe we are selfish, we become selfish. Change the story.

line: Self-Fulfilling Prophecy, Manifest: say it happens, it happens. If we believe we are selfish, we become selfish. Change the story.

card.name: Hope
card.power: The Verb: Restart the game if you lose.
card.lore: Hope is a verb with its sleeves rolled up. (Ref: Solnit/Orr)

line: Hope, the Verb: restart the game if you lose. Hope is a verb with its sleeves rolled up.

card.name: Blödsinn! (Nonsense)
card.power: Interrupt: Cancel the last action. Shout 'BlödsInn!'
card.lore: When the story gets boring or fake, hit the reset button.

line: Blödsinn! (Nonsense) Interrupt: cancel the last action, shout Blödsinn! When the story gets boring or fake, hit the reset button.

card.name: Kayfabizarro
card.power: The Work: Treat the game as real. Overact your next turn.
card.lore: It's fake, but the emotion is real. That's the point.

opener: You with the card in your hand
line: Kayfabizarro, the Work: treat it as real, overact. It's fake, but the emotion is real. That's the point.

card.name: The Scissors
card.power: Cut: Physically cut a card in half to destroy it forever.
card.lore: The ultimate tool of the DIY anarchist.

line: The Scissors, Cut? Physically cut a card in half, destroyed forever. The ultimate tool of the DIY anarchist.

card.name: The Glue Stick
card.power: Mashup: Stick two cards together permanently.
card.lore: Make connections where there are none.

line: The Glue Stick, Mashup: stick two cards together permanently. Make connections where there are none.
